meta.description: Places a copy of a geometry on every point, for example a leaf on the points of points_on_path or the kinks of trunk_kink.

plant.description: The paths the points sit on, the instances are added to them.

geometry.description: One geometry, or a list of them from a join node or a leaf_surface with variants. Every instance picks one of them at random. A link without geometry places nothing.

size.description: The size of the instances, relative to the path at the point.

angle.description: Tilts every instance from the direction of its point, in radians: positive toward the tip of the path, negative toward its base, 1.5708 rad along it. Read for every instance.
